history.claim: The ceremony was held as a morning activity during the 12th From Takola to Takua Pa tourism promotion event at the Takua Pa governor's residence on 3 March 2026 (2569).
history.quote: Morning session, Takua Pa ruler worshipping ceremony

history.claim: An archaeological database notes that every year, the Takua Pa Town Municipality and the community organise a merit making ceremony for monks at the governor's residence, serving as a memorial ceremony for the site.
history.quote: Every year, the Takua Pa Town Municipality together with the community in the municipal area organise the event

history.claim: The original governor's residence was located near Wat Na Mueang in the Talat Yai area, and Takua Pa flourished from tin mining, especially since the reign of King Rama V.
history.quote: Takua Pa reached its peak prosperity from tin mining

history.claim: The governor's residence wall was registered as an ancient monument in the Royal Gazette on 18 December 1996 (2539).
history.quote: Announced the registration as an ancient monument and determined the land boundary of the ancient monument

history.claim: The wall is a rectangular structure dividing the area into a front palace, a hall, and a rear palace; sources do not verify the Sino-Portuguese architecture of the wall itself.
history.quote: Inside the wall is divided into 3 parts

timeline.title: Takua Pa recovered after the war
timeline.detail: After the town was destroyed in 1809 (2352), a new town was established at Ban Talat Yai during the reign of King Rama III.

timeline.title: Town centre relocation
timeline.detail: The town centre was relocated to Ban Yan Yao because the waterway became shallow and Ban Talat Yai declined in importance.

timeline.title: Registered as an ancient monument
timeline.detail: The Fine Arts Department announced the registration of the governor's residence wall as an ancient monument and determined its land boundary.

timeline.title: Worshipping ceremony in the 12th From Takola to Takua Pa event
timeline.detail: The municipality organised a morning ceremony at the governor's residence, followed by a Buddhist chanting ceremony.

timeline.title: Construction of the governor's residence began
timeline.detail: Built after the town's recovery around Ban Talat Yai during the reign of King Rama III, but found sources do not specify the exact year and builder.

news.title: Phang Nga province organised the 12th From Takola to Takua Pa event
news.summary: The municipality organised an old town tourism promotion event between 28 February and 3 March 2026 (2569), using the governor's residence as a venue with a worshipping ceremony on 3 March.

nearby.name: Takua Pa old market / Si Takua Pa road

visit.best_time: Morning of the ceremony day; the event date varies according to the annual project
visit.opening_hours: The ancient monument area can be visited every day; times for the ceremony itself are not found
visit.admission_fee: No admission fee for the ancient monument area

history.claim: People in Takua Pa district have inherited the vegetarian festival tradition for over a century.
history.quote: The vegetarian practice has been ongoing for over a hundred years

history.claim: The tradition aims for participants to observe precepts, abstain from non vegetarian food, and refrain from harming animals.
history.quote: Think good, speak good, do good

history.claim: Local sources state the tradition's connection with the Hokkien Chinese community and its inheritance in Takua Pa town.
history.quote: Chinese people in Phuket province call it Jia Chai

history.claim: Official evidence stating the starting year, founder, specific roles during the mining era, architecture, or ancient monument registration of the tradition itself has not been found.

timeline.title: The municipality organised a 9 day 9 night vegetarian festival
timeline.detail: Held at the Takua Pa market area, featuring a vegetarian precept campaign, vegetarian food, and activities for town relations and tourism.

timeline.title: Takua Pa old town event returned, gathering 29 shrines
timeline.detail: Phang Nga province, the municipality, and shrine representatives promoted the event with rituals, parades, and vegetarian food in the old town.

timeline.title: Starting year not found
timeline.detail: There is still no official or academic evidence specifying the founder and the starting year of the Takua Pa vegetarian festival.

timeline.title: Formed in a port and tin mining town society
timeline.detail: Takua Pa town community received a large number of Chinese labourers during the mining era and inherited Chinese culture including the vegetarian tradition, with Talat Yai serving as the community centre.

news.title: Press conference ready for Takua Pa old town vegetarian festival activities
news.summary: Promoted the event for 3 to 11 October 2024 (2567), specifying 29 participating shrines and vegetarian halls.

visit.best_time: During the vegetarian festival, which generally falls in October, according to the 1st to 9th waxing moon days of the 9th Chinese lunar month

vegetarian.address_line: Si Takua Pa road and Talat Yai community area, Takua Pa old town

history.claim: The Takua Pa Town Municipality included the Loy Krathong festival in its religious, cultural, and recreational plans.
Municipal documents specify krathong making contests, stage performances, and exhibitions or pier decorations.
In 2025 (2568), Loy Krathong activities were held at Khlong Takua Pa in Takua Pa subdistrict and at Khlong Bang Muang in Bang Muang subdistrict, with a large number of people participating.
history.quote: A large number of people came to participate in Loy Krathong

history.claim: The Talat Yai community in Takua Pa town regularly hosts Loy Krathong activities as it is located near water sources.
history.quote: Loy Krathong event ... this activity happens every year

timeline.title: The municipality included the event in cultural plans
timeline.detail: The plans outline krathong making contests, performances, and pier decorations.

timeline.title: Event held at Khlong Takua Pa and Khlong Bang Muang
timeline.detail: News states that a large number of people participated in Loy Krathong.

timeline.title: Evidence of the starting year in Takua Pa not found
timeline.detail: The name of the initiator or verifiable specific local reasons have not yet been found.

news.title: Loy Krathong activities at Khlong Takua Pa and Khlong Bang Muang
news.summary: The Department of Marine and Coastal Resources reported the 2025 (2568) event and the large participation of the public.

visit.best_time: During the Loy Krathong festival, with event dates varying according to the lunar calendar and local announcements

loy-krathong.address_line: Around Khlong Takua Pa and venues designated by local administrative organisations
